Cosmic Cargo Optimization

A spacecraft's hold has a weight capacity of exactly W interstellar units. You have N cargo items, each with a specific weight and a profit value. Each item can be taken at most once.

Select a subset of items to maximize the total profit without exceeding the cargo capacity W. This is the classic 0/1 Knapsack problem under strict competitive programming constraints: N up to 2000 and item weights from 1 to 104.
explanation: This is the 0/1 Knapsack problem solved with standard DP. Define dp[w] as the maximum profit achievable using a single-dimensional rolling weight array up to capacity w. Process items one by one; for each item, iterate capacity from W down to item weight, ensuring each item is used at most once. Time Complexity: O(N*W). This is feasible for N=2000, W=10000.
